evidence.reason: Production currently stores the exact death endpoint as 1657-08-06 but labels that endpoint Julian. The Encyclopedia of the History of Ukraine gives the paired dates as 06.08 (27.07).1657, i.e. 6 August in the Gregorian/new-style representation and 27 July in the Julian/old-style representation. Preserve the existing 1657-08-06 endpoint and correct only its calendar metadata from julian to gregorian.
evidence.source: Encyclopedia of the History of Ukraine, Bohdan Khmelnytsky
